_notes.comfy_root: Path to ComfyUI_windows_portable folder (or equivalent). Derived paths: input/, ComfyUI/output/
_notes.ffmpeg_path: Absolute path to ffmpeg.exe (or 'ffmpeg' if on PATH)
_notes.project_root: Project root. null = auto-detect from this config file's parent directory
_notes.ollama_url: Ollama API endpoint — only used by the Ollama provider. Default http://127.0.0.1:11434.
_notes.driver: Settings for the agent driver loop (used by both driver/ollama_agent.py CLI and the web-driven /api/run/* routes in driver/serve.py). Set api_keys (here or from the viewer's Run panel) to enable the online providers. Optional: anthropic_models / gemini_models / openai_models, each a list of model ids, pin that provider's dropdown instead of listing models live from its API.
_notes.ollama_vision_hints: Extra substrings appended to Ollama's vision-model filter (e.g. ['my-custom-vlm']). The defaults already cover qwen-vl, qwen3.8, llama-vision, llava, minicpm-v, moondream, bakllava, gemma3, gemma4, pixtral, molmo. Add an entry here when you pull a vision model whose name doesn't match any of those — otherwise it won't appear in the viewer's model dropdown.
_notes.ollama_keep_alive: Ollama keep_alive parameter — how long to keep the chat model in (V)RAM after each response. Default 0 (unload immediately) so ComfyUI/LTX can take the GPU back for t2v generation. Big vision models (gemma3:27b, qwen2.5vl:32b) won't fit alongside LTX 2.3 on a 16-24 GB consumer GPU; the unload-then-reload cycle costs ~30-60s per tick but still wins big over CPU-only inference. Accepts int seconds, '5m'/'1h' strings, or '-1' (keep loaded forever — use when GPU has headroom for both, or in pure-CPU mode where reload means re-reading from disk).
_notes.segment_cap: Hard ceiling on segments per journey for the web / Ollama driver. 0 (default) = none: a trip ends when the agent ends it, or when you press Rest or Stop. The agent is never told this number.
_notes.t2v_workflow: Filename (without .json) of the t2v workflow under workflows/. Default 'video_ltx2.3_t2v'. To use a different one, drop the workflow JSON into workflows/, register the prompt/image/filename node IDs in driver/tolive.py's _VIDEO_WF_NODES table, then change this value. Currently registered: video_ltx2.3_t2v, video_ltx2_3_i2v, video_ltx2_3_flf2v.
